for(i in 1:52)
EX1<- list("C:/Users/gujac/Downloads/Fotos Cruzamento/.jpg")
plotRGB(EX1, r = 1, g = 2, b = 3)
EX1.RemSoil <- fieldMask(mosaic = EX1, Red = 1, Green = 2, Blue = 3, index = "HUE")
EX1<-aggregate(EX1,fact=4)
EX1.Shape<-fieldShape(mosaic = EX1.RemSoil, ncols = 40, nrows = 24, extent=T)
EX1.SC<- fieldCount(mosaic = EX1.RemSoil$mask, fieldShape = EX1.Shape$fieldShape, n.core = 3, cex=0.4, col="blue", minSize = 0.05)
EX1.SC$fieldCount
Result1<- EX1.SC$fieldCount
EX1.Canopy<-fieldArea(mosaic = EX1.RemSoil$mask, fieldShape = EX1.SC$fieldShape)
EX1.Canopy$fieldShape
Obj1<- (EX1.Canopy$areaPorcent$objArea)
median(Obj1)
Result2<- median(Obj1)

Sorry for the wait. this is the sript i use. in the first part, i calibrate on the first picture my analysis, and then i do it on all the pictures :

### START ###
####################################################################################
# clean data : 
####################################################################################
remove (list=ls())

# Required packages
####################################################################################

library(parallel)
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)
library(FIELDimageR)
library(raster)


######################
# calibrate analysis on the first picture
######################

Img1<-stack("name of the first picture.tif")
plotRGB(Img1,r=1,g=2,b=3)
Img1<-aggregate(Img1,fact=2)
Img1.Indices<- fieldIndex(mosaic = Img1, index = c("BGI","GLI","HUE","BI","SCI","HI"))  # testing all the indice to see the most usefull
EX.L.Shape<-fieldPolygon(mosaic=Img1, extent=T, plot=F) # extent=T (The whole image area will be the shapefile)
EX.L2<-fieldMask(mosaic=Img1, index = "HUE" , cropValue=0, cropAbove=T, plot=T) # myIndex =c("Green")  or  index = "BGI"

EX.L.count<-fieldCount(mosaic = EX.L2$mask, fieldShape = EX.L.Shape$fieldShape, minSize = 0.005, cex=0.6, col="Red")
EX.L.count$fieldCount

# Images names (folder directory: "./images/") : indiquer le chemin d'acc?s au fichier photo
chem="C:/Users/XXXXXXX/Desktop/Your work folder/Pictures/"
pics<-list.files(chem)   # ,pattern="part of pics name to select only some"



# Vegetation indices (choose index you want to use)
index<- c("BGI","VARI","GLI","NGRDI")



################

### Parallel ###

################



# Number of cores (detect max nuber of core to use)

n.core<-detectCores()-1



# Starting parallel (make turn all the follwing code on all the pictures in the folder)

cl <- makeCluster(n.core, output = "")

registerDoParallel(cl)

system.time({
  
  EX.Table.Parallel <- foreach(i = 1:length(pics), .packages = c("raster","FIELDimageR"),
                               
                               .combine = rbind) %dopar% {
                        
                                 EX.L1<-stack(paste(chem,pics[i],sep = ""))
                                 
                                 EX.L1<-aggregate(EX.L1,fact=2) #Reducing image resolution (fast analysis)
                                 
                                 EX.L.Shape<-fieldPolygon(mosaic=EX.L1, extent=T, plot=F) # extent=T (The whole image area will be the shapefile)
                                 
                                 EX.L2<-fieldMask(mosaic=EX.L1, index = "HUE" , cropValue=0, cropAbove=T, plot=F) # Select one index to identify leaves and remove the background. use the values you have select in the first step
                                 
                                #  choose only the fonction you want to use, to note take too much time for nothing
                                # EX.L4<-fieldIndex(mosaic=EX.L2$newMosaic, index=index, plot=F)    # Index measure
                                 
                                # EX.L.Info<- fieldInfo(mosaic=EX.L4[[index]], fieldShape=EX.L.Shape$fieldShape, projection=F) # projection=F (Ignore projection. Normally used only with remote sensing images)
                                # EX.L.Info$plotValue
                                 
                                 # measure leaf area per plot:
                                 #Img.canopy<-fieldArea(mosaic=EX.L2$mask,fieldShape=EX.L.Shape$fieldShape, plot=F)
                                 #Img.canopy$areaPorcent  # Combine information from all images in one table
                                 
                                 # counting number of plant per plot
                                 EX.L.count<-fieldCount(mosaic = EX.L2$mask, fieldShape = EX.L.Shape$fieldShape, minSize = 0.005, cex=0.6, col="Red")  # use the value you have test in the first step
                                 EX.L.count$fieldCount
                                 
                                 
                                 # Autre indicatur ? calculer....
                                 # Img1.Info<-fieldInfo(mosaic=Img1.SC$fieldCount,fieldShape = Img1.SC$fieldShape, na.rm=TRUE)
                                 
                                 # on associe les deux vecteur pour ajouter ? la table: 
                                 cbind(EX.L.count$fieldCount) # EX.L.Info$plotValue, ,Img.canopy$areaPorcent
                                 
                               }})


rownames(EX.Table.Parallel)<-pics
EX.Table.Parallel
setwd("C:/Users/XXXXXXX/Desktop/your work folder/")
write.csv2(EX.Table.Parallel,"name of your file.csv") # create a csv file with all the results



### END ###




 I hope it will help you.
